object: 950 litre diesel day tank: rectangular sheet-steel tank on an angle-iron stand with a drip tray
understanding: The tank is welded sheet: flat sides dish in when struck and the corners hold. The stand is angle iron: legs bend and the whole thing leans rather than crumpling.
Hurt by vehicles and loads swung into its sides, and by collapse of a leg. A full tank resists; an empty one dents easily.
Rust at welds, the stand feet, the drip tray (always wet), round the filler and sight glass; diesel stains run down from the fittings.
